LanguageData.AyameICCT_HoloSignboard.label: holographic cha chaan teng franchise sign
LanguageData.AyameICCT_HoloSignboard.description: An electronic sign for an Interstellar Cha Chaan Teng franchise. Place online orders and contact the restaurant here.\nIts down-to-earth charm is reassuring, though wandering artists on the rim occasionally have something to say about its taste.
LanguageData.AyameICCT_WallHoloSignboard.label: wall-mounted holographic cha chaan teng sign
LanguageData.AyameICCT_WallHoloSignboard.description: A wall-mounted electronic sign for an Interstellar Cha Chaan Teng franchise. Place online orders and contact the restaurant here.\nThe sign cycles through the chef's signature dish, “Sorrowful Rice”. Wandering artists on the rim may still despise its red-and-green color scheme, but the rich aroma of char siu seems almost to waft through the holographic screen.
